span.p:
take the build lock
back up go.mod and go.sum

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
dry run: go build -a -x -n
list of compile commands, build-plan.log

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
auto-pin: write otel.instrumentation.go,
edit go.mod for the hook modules

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
match hook rules against
the packages in the plan

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
generate otelc.runtime.go
for the main package

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
tool -V=full
answer gets an otelc marker,
so cache keys differ from plain builds

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
compile of a matched package:
rewrite the AST (trampoline calls,
//go:linkname declarations, struct fields),
add files, patch importcfg, strip -complete

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
link: add the packages the
compile step introduced to importcfg

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
restore go.mod and go.sum,
keep .otelc-build/ for inspection
